word-visa.def: an official stamp or document that lets you enter a country

word-residence-permit.def: an official document that allows a foreigner to live in a country

word-permanent-residence.def: the legal right of a foreigner to live in a country for as long as they want

word-temporary-residence.def: official permission for a foreigner to stay in a country only for a limited time

word-work-permit.def: an official document that lets a foreigner have a job in a country

word-citizenship.def: the legal status of belonging to a country, with rights such as voting and holding its passport

word-naturalization.def: the process of a foreigner becoming a legal member of a new country

word-immigration.def: the act of moving to a foreign country to live there

word-immigration-office.def: a government office that deals with foreigners who enter or live in a country

word-consulate.def: an office in a foreign city where officials help citizens of their own country

word-application.def: a formal request, often written on a form, for something such as a visa or a job

word-signature.def: your name written by hand in your own style at the end of a document

word-official-stamp.def: a mark pressed in ink onto a document to show that an office has approved it

word-original-document.def: the first paper itself, not a photocopy or a duplicate

word-certified-copy.def: a photocopy that an official has confirmed is exactly like the first paper

word-sworn-translator.def: a person approved by a court to turn documents into another language for official use

word-notary.def: a person with legal authority to witness and confirm documents and signatures

word-apostille.def: a special stamp that makes a public document valid in other countries that joined an international treaty

word-legalization.def: the official process of confirming that a foreign document is genuine so it can be used in a country

word-birth-certificate.def: an official paper that records the date and place a person came into the world

word-marriage-certificate.def: an official paper that proves two people are legally husband and wife

word-criminal-record-certificate.def: an official paper from the police showing whether you have ever been punished by a court for breaking the law

word-health-insurance.def: a plan you pay into that covers the cost of medical care when you are ill

word-proof-of-address.def: a paper, such as a bill, that shows the place where you live

word-proof-of-income.def: a paper, such as a pay stub, that shows how much money you earn

word-passport-photo.def: a small picture of your face taken in a standard way for official documents

word-fingerprints.def: the unique patterns on your fingertips that officials record to identify you

word-fee.def: money you pay to an office or professional for a service

word-extension.def: a longer period of time that an office gives you before a deadline or end date

word-renew.def: to make a document or permission valid for another period of time

word-expire.def: to reach the date when something is no longer valid

word-valid.def: accepted by the law or an office, and not past its end date

word-invalid.def: not accepted by the law or an office, for example because it is out of date

word-approve.def: to officially say yes to a request or plan

word-reject.def: to officially say no to a request or application

word-appeal.def: to ask a higher authority to change a decision that you think is wrong

word-ministry.def: a large government department in charge of one area, such as education or foreign affairs

word-municipality.def: a town or city with its own local government

word-address-registration.def: the official recording of where you live with the local authorities

word-register-address.def: to tell the local authorities officially where you live

word-deregister.def: to cancel your official record at a place, for example when you move away

word-tax-number.def: a personal number that the government gives you to track the money you pay to it

word-personal-id-number.def: a unique number that a country gives each person for official records

word-residence-card.def: a plastic card that shows a foreigner is allowed to live in a country

word-deportation.def: the act of forcing a foreigner to leave a country

word-asylum.def: protection that a country gives to people who are in danger in their own country

word-refugee.def: a person who has left their country because of war, danger or fear of harm

word-family-reunification.def: the process that lets close relatives join a person who already lives abroad

word-social-security-number-us.def: a nine-digit number the US government gives to each person for work and benefits records

word-green-card-us.def: a US card showing that a foreigner has the right to live and work there for good
